apps.localizedDescription:
What is rfvp?:

• See setsusmei for details.
• You can even use rfvp as an Operation System! Turn on your computer and boot with the UEFI program.

Console support:

These are game frames captured from RFVP running in emulators.

rfvp debug HUD:

• Enable it with F2 hotkey (Fn + F2 on MacOS).
• Only desktop platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS) for now.

Custom Font:

• By default, the engine uses a built-in font that is compatible with all original games. However, you can also use a custom font by put a ttf file in the font directory under the game data directory.
